name: mq_getsetattr
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_mq_getsetattr, mqd_t mqdes, const struct mq_attr *newattr, struct mq_attr *oldattr);
description: This is a low-level system call used to get and set attributes for a message queue. It should not be used directly, as it is intended for implementing higher-level functions like mq_getattr(3) and mq_setattr(3); for details, refer to mq_setattr(3).

parameters.name: newattr
parameters.description: Pointer to new attributes to set, or NULL if not setting

parameters.name: oldattr
parameters.description: Pointer to store the old attributes

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error and sets errno

bugs: This system call should not be used directly; it is intended for use in implementing C library functions.
